summary: Anthropic announced a partnership with Tata Consultancy Services to deploy Claude to 50,000 TCS employees and build Claude-powered products for clients in financial services, healthcare, the public sector and other regulated industries.

mechanisms.reason: A large-scale enterprise rollout across tens of thousands of employees and millions of end customers increases aggregate token consumption.
mechanisms.quote: TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 of its own employees across 56 countries

categories.reason: Claude is being packaged into lending advisory products for banks, extending into financial services workflows.
categories.quote: such as claims processing for insurers and lending advisory for banks

categories.reason: Claude is being deployed into insurance claims processing and a life-and-pensions business serving millions of policyholders.
categories.quote: Diligenta , TCS’s UK life and pensions business, will use Claude to improve the customer experience for the more than 22 million policyholders it serves.

practices.reason: New Claude Code plugins and skills for claims adjudication and lending advisory create integration surface for teams building on the Claude Code ecosystem.
practices.quote: TCS’s engineering teams will add reusable skills and plugins to the Claude Code ecosystem, starting with ones focused on claims adjudication and lending advisory.
